headings: H2: An Heirloom in Full Bloom
H2: M&S Schmalberg x Hanni Brooch
H2: Water Balm In Sparkling Palmarosa
paragraphs: Since 1916, M&S Schmalberg has handmade fabric flowers in the heart of New York’s garment district, for runways, couture houses, and the pages of Vogue.
Four generations later, they still use the same vintage process, with some flower molds dating back to the early 1900s.
This holiday, they made one just for us: a limited-edition brooch in soft, sheer berry petals. It finishes a look and outlasts every trend.
It’s the kind of piece that gets passed down, not put away. A bloom to wear alongside Sparkling Palmarosa, for a floral you can see and smell.
Crafted by hand in New York’s garment district using M&S Schmalberg’s heirloom process, unchanged since 1916.
A holiday-only bloom, made in limited quantities while supplies last.
